documents.title: 招生管道 · Admissions pathways
documents.method: Official public page visible in existing browser capture
documents.content: The public homepage links eight admissions pathways under https://reg.aca.stu.edu.tw/: graduate_school (doctoral, master and in-service master), daytime_bd_program (daytime bachelor), continuing_es (continuing education), school_transfer (summer/winter transfer), industry_ac (industry collaboration), camp_st (campus/camp programs), school_other (other admissions categories), overseas_admissions (international, overseas Chinese, Hong Kong and Macao students). New students use https://freshman.stu.edu.tw/. Admission dates, fees, requirements, acceptance and eligibility are not supplied by this directory; read the current official program announcement.

documents.title: 註冊課務組電話與服務 · Registrar contact and academic records
documents.method: Official search-index excerpt; full page currently unreachable
documents.content: 教務處註冊課務組 Registration and Curriculum Division (registrar) can be reached through 07-6158000 / +886 7 6158000, extensions 2007, 2009, 2010, 2012, 2014 or 2016. The academic service mailbox is course@stu.edu.tw. The indexed official FAQ lists registration, enrollment status, leave/resumption/withdrawal, student cards, enrollment certificates, transcripts, course grades, absences, minors/double majors, credit programs, credit transfer, degree exams, closures and teaching management as academic-services subjects. Admissions and Selection Division extensions are 2004, 2005, 2006, 2015, 2017 and 2021. Extensions depend on the issue; do not invent a single assigned contact. Official-page indexed extract observed 2026-11-03; the search index reports a crawl about two months earlier, and direct retrieval is currently unavailable. Confirm current staffing or changed extensions with the main operator.

documents.title: 休學復學退學聯絡 · Leave, resumption and withdrawal contact
documents.method: Official search-index excerpt; full page currently unreachable
documents.content: For questions about student leave, resumption and withdrawal contact the Registration and Curriculum Division at (07)615-8000 extensions 2009, 2010, 2012 or 2016 during office hours. A status change or refund must be handled through the official process; the chatbot cannot approve a school status change or calculate an official refund from incomplete information. This indexed contact excerpt was observed 2026-11-03, with the index last crawling the page about two months earlier. Confirm the current procedure with the office.

documents.title: 繳費減免住宿聯絡 · Fees, aid and housing offices
documents.method: Official search-index excerpt; full page currently unreachable
documents.content: The official Cashier service page's indexed contact list uses school phone (07)615-8000. Registration payment: Cashier 總務處出納組 extension 2208. Tuition reductions: Student Affairs 生輔組 extension 2140. Disadvantaged-student aid: 生輔組 extension 2126. Student loan: 生輔組 extension 2124. Two-year junior college reductions/loans: Continuing Education extension 2511. Accommodation: housing service 住服組 extension 2136. For payment slips use the official registration/payment page; this app does not receive payments or know the student's actual university balance. This extract was observed 2026-11-03 with a source-index crawl about two months earlier; confirm current extensions and amounts before paying.

documents.title: 教務常見問題 · Academic service FAQ
documents.method: Official search-index excerpt; full page currently unreachable
documents.content: The indexed official academic FAQ says cross-department courses may be taken in principle, but whether another department opens a course and whether it counts toward graduation depends on the relevant department's graduation rules. Transcripts are requested at the automatic transcript machine outside the Academic Affairs office on the first floor of the Administration Building; the extract describes immediate collection for Chinese transcripts and at most four working days for English transcripts. These are reference descriptions, not a guarantee of current hours or processing time. Ask course@stu.edu.tw or the registrar to confirm current procedure. The FAQ extract was observed 2026-11-03; full-page access is unavailable and the index reports a crawl about two months earlier.

documents.title: School Affairs entry and knowledge-management separation
documents.method: Client route and account-boundary implementation reviewed November 3
documents.content: School Affairs is at /school-affairs and its logged-out entry is /school-affairs/login. Continue with Google authenticates an independent stu.best account using only basic profile, email and identity scopes; it never asks for a university password or access to Gmail messages. Google sign-in does not import official university records or grant staff roles. New accounts receive student access. The portal shows only an authorized linked student record, or states that no record is linked. Public school answers require no sign-in; signed-in Assistant answers use only the separate School Affairs session and records authorized by its trusted role and RLS. Signing out clears that session and conversation without signing out Nexus. STU Nexus at /signin and /app/knowledge is a separate knowledge-management workspace. Signing into the knowledge manager does not sign into School Affairs or provide a student identity. Official university services remain external links and require their own authorized school login.

documents.title: Student account, subjects and learning guide
documents.method: Verified client application behavior and permissions
documents.content: Internal Nexus workspace documentation, unrelated to School Affairs student authentication. Sign in to STU Nexus at /signin to ask about your app subjects, enrolled classes, learning materials, announcements, schedule, released grades, attendance and support requests. The school must enroll you in classes before they appear; public signup does not automatically create academic enrollment. The Assistant may help navigate, explain learning concepts, prepare a student-owned support or staff-message request, request an attendance correction and mark lesson progress after confirmation. It cannot complete or submit graded work, select exam answers, change roles or school identity, finalize grades, pay tuition, or access unconnected school systems. If no enrollment is visible it should say so, not treat the public subject catalog as your timetable. Public email confirmation still needs the client's production sender; an ordinary public inbox may not receive the default Supabase message.

documents.title: Teacher and staff Assistant actions
documents.method: Verified client Assistant tools and authorization
documents.content: Internal Nexus workspace documentation, unrelated to School Affairs student authentication. Faculty can use their assigned class workspace to prepare modules, lessons and rich material pages, draft assessments and questions, post announcements, manage attendance and schedule events. Authorized academic operators can also manage programs, terms, subjects, sections, enrollments and draft curriculum plans through their permitted tools. Support/advisor roles can prepare support or communication requests. Leadership has role-allowed initiative workflows. Draft changes mode prepares one exact action at a time; the user reviews and confirms each mutation, then the bounded agent loop checks the real result before continuing. Ask mode makes no changes. Destructive actions require clear confirmation, and existing RLS/RPC rules still decide authorization. The Assistant never changes credentials/roles or finalizes grades, and it cannot operate external official school systems. For walkthroughs open /app/help.

documents.title: Manage the chatbot knowledge base
documents.method: Client knowledge lifecycle and role policy
documents.content: Internal Nexus workspace documentation, unrelated to School Affairs student authentication. Owner, administrator and librarian roles manage chatbot sources and documents at /app/knowledge. Add sources, import URL/text/Markdown/PDF content, set public/institution/role/class/staff audiences, review extracted chunks, publish an approved version, set effective/expiry/review dates, and roll back to a prior version. New imports are drafts until a reviewer publishes them. Public questions search only eligible public material; signed-in questions additionally search published sources their own account can access. Source refresh creates a new reviewable version rather than silently replacing published facts. Expired, future, superseded, quarantined, draft or role-ineligible evidence must not answer questions. A checked reference or indexed excerpt is not a university endorsement or institutional research approval.
